metadata.title: Clicked like I was wrestling a squirrel and somehow snagged that 1 kill? Valorant, explain pls
metadata.description:
Me: panic clicking like I’m allergic to aiming
Enemy: probably questioning existence
Valorant said ‘Here’s a kill, take it’
If your aim’s a meme but you still get kills, you feel me

Click if your aim is a mystery but kills keep happening!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
